`search.wav` is a synthetic 16 kHz mono PCM recording generated for this project
with macOS speech synthesis. It contains no campus recording or personal data.
Its authored script is:

> Breadth first search explores a graph level by level. A queue stores the
> vertices that we still need to visit.

The native smoke test checks meaningful recognition and original-clock word
alignment, rather than requiring an exact transcript from a probabilistic model.
